Rink dimensions

Source: R/dimensions.R
rink_dims.Rd

Named lists describing a rink's markings, in metres, with the origin at the bottom-left corner of the boards: x runs along the length of the rink (left end boards to right end boards) and y across its width. IIHF is the standard 60 x 30 m international rink, NHL the 200 x 85 ft North American rink converted to metres. Use rink_dimensions() to derive a variant.

Usage

IIHF

NHL

Format

A named list. Geometry fields are in metres: length, width, blue_line and end_line (distance from the end boards), faceoff_dot_x / faceoff_dot_y (end-zone dot offsets from the corner), nz_faceoff_dot (neutral-zone dot offset from the blue line), faceoff_circle (radius), the hash-mark, crease and goal measures, and corner_border_start_x / corner_border_start_y (corner radii). origin_x / origin_y place the corner of the boards in data coordinates, lines_small / lines_big are the ggplot2 line widths for thin and thick markings, and type is "IIHF" or "NHL".

An object of class list of length 31.

An object of class list of length 31.

See also

rink_dimensions(), annotate_rink(), rink_geometry()

Examples

IIHF$length
#> [1] 60
NHL$length
#> [1] 60.96
